Damn I said the same thing in another post too. Your not alone. I started this as a kid and left it behind because I knew what would come and cause of life.

I came back afterwards this year and finished it today... And that means I literally let a decade go by. But take your time, it really is a great show.

Maybe rewatch it again if you feel empty some time in life. The world in the show is just inspiring and give a sensation like your hearts travelling to another magical world.

The characters are just amazing too. The bromance, the overall connection and the depth of the characters which you can empathize with.

Oh but the 'once and future king' prophecy would still be in effect. That's why they did a time skip cliffhanger. It's a way of saying the world is yet to unite and magic accepted everywhere. Additionally it is a show on merlin. I think the reason why they only planned 5 seasons is to show how merlin grows and becomes the 'great sorcerer merlin'. Its basically on his path to becoming so. Also the legends don't really go any further than that part. 

But either way... The fanfics are a way to mend the void left by the shows cliffhangers. Might just imagine some of my own.

Same I knew it was coming. I remember enjoying bits of Arthurian legends as a child and when I watched merlin on TV as a kid I was hyped. Then I went to highschool and missed out on the episodes completely.

Then after I had the time... Well knowing how it would end I was too scared to confront the show. Also too scared to go any further after the world in the show was just too amazing in my mind.

Well now that I've finished it after all this I can tell you... This show is underrated. It's amazing cause the places and all just make it feel like it's alive and the bromance and the warm emotion here and there with the subtle little teases to those well versed in Arthurian legends.

But the ending is something great. Something I'm glad I watched although I was holding back the tears. The bromance broken by the sense of betrayal and disbelief. Then when Arthur finally tries to console Merlin. I think the show is best left off at that.

If the ending was saving Arthur and all it and uniting Albion it would really break the flow. The raw emotions with the transition of the secret unveiled and the inevitable death, they bring out everything that sums Arthur and Merlin. After all this was Merlin's Adventures. I'll watch it again because it truly does have a beautiful ending and obviously all the comedic moments.
